scope: Production full-source scan compared against 10 selected manually reviewed preview shot/outcome references. NOT exhaustive source labels, NOT full-source precision/recall. Template-derived examples excluded from held-out tally. No auto-calibration.

rows.label: preview-1

limitations: Icon identity is profile-specific; no player-name OCR is performed.
Template cosine similarity is not a probability.
Missing nearby audio leaves visual detections uncertain.
ROI guards do not identify every scene cut.
Visual timing is quantized to the configured sample rate.

rows.reference_method: assistant sampled POV firing and skull/outcome frames; numerical local waveform refinement, not automatic kill certification
rows.caveat: The preview label confirms gameplay outcome, not the exact onset or presence of this ROI icon.
